name: @vrmxg/coverage
description: VRMXG coverage cameras (M4 W8): cameras for a script's shots by rule from the script and the marks (an establishing wide per scene, shot / reverse shot on the 180° line, close-ups on beats, two-shots for overlap), each a VirtualCamera on one of M2's rig presets; the 180° rule as a lint; replacing a shot's camera as one undoable edit; the storyboard's data and thumbnails per shot rendered from snapshots. Deterministic: the same script and marks give the same cameras, byte for byte.
